note: Subject texts of the Candy faction (bead pulp_wars-jdb.5, docs/art/factions/CANDY.md, spec docs/product/RULESET_7_CANDY.md section 15.4). The faction has fixed colours: cotton-candy pink glaze and frosting #ffb8d8 shaded rose #e58fb5, marshmallow white and cream, caramel, biscuit wafer and chocolate browns, a hard white highlight on every glossy surface, tiny pastel sprinkles and a little mint trim; no owner colour. Every design is original: generic sweets with faces, no character of any show.

subjects.UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER: Subject: Gumdrop, a chunky cute living gumdrop soldier with no separate head and no neck: the whole figure is one big fat dome-shaped gumdrop, flat at the bottom and round on top like a thimble, of glossy cotton-candy pink jelly, colour #ffb8d8, dusted with small white sugar crystals, with one big hard white highlight on its top; the face is in the middle of the dome itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small happy smile; two tiny stubby pink arms on the sides of the dome and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet directly under it; it holds one oversized candy-cane spear with pink and white stripes and a pointed tip upright in one hand, and a round pale biscuit wafer shield with a waffle grid on its other arm; no helmet, no hair, no shirt and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:GUARD: Subject: Marshmallow, a chunky cute living marshmallow guard: the whole body is one big fat square block of matte marshmallow white, soft with rounded corners and shaded with pale warm cream, wider than a soldier and as tall as the image allows; the face is on the block itself, two big round black dot eyes, two small cotton-candy pink cheeks and a small calm smile; two short stubby white arms and two short stubby white legs with flat feet; it holds one big square graham-cracker shield of warm caramel biscuit brown with rows of small holes in front of its body; no weapon, no helmet and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT: Subject: a giant living gummy jelly sweet, a chubby jelly figure moulded in one piece like a jelly baby, standing upright: a smooth rounded body of glossy translucent pink jelly, colour #f4a0c4, one single pink colour all over from head to feet, a little lighter in its middle where light shines through and shaded with a deeper rose pink at its edges, with long hard white shine streaks on its head and on its round tummy; a big round head with two small round ears on top, a fat round body, two short stubby rounded arms held up like a boxer and two short stubby rounded legs, all smooth lumps of the same pink jelly with no paws and no fingers; the face is only two small black dot eyes and a tiny smile pressed into the jelly; it holds nothing and wears nothing; wide and heavy, bigger than a soldier; simple smooth shapes and very few details; clearly a jelly sweet, not a plush toy and not an animal.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Rock Candy Golem, a huge towering chunky golem built of big angular rock-candy sugar crystals, far taller than a soldier: a broad body, huge shoulders and thick arms and legs made of big faceted crystal chunks of glossy cotton-candy pink and marshmallow white sugar with hard white highlights, held together by thick bands of warm caramel brown dripping at the joints; a small blocky crystal head set low between the shoulders with two round black dot eyes and a straight caramel mouth; two huge crystal fists hanging low; a few sharp crystal points on its shoulders and back; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:RAIDER: Subject: Donut Racer, a chunky cute rider on a rolling donut: one big fat ring donut standing upright on its edge like a wheel, of golden biscuit-brown dough with thick glossy cotton-candy pink frosting, colour #ffb8d8, dripping over its top half, a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a round hole in its middle; sitting astride the top of the donut, one small living candy-corn sweet, a little cone-shaped rider with a white pointed tip, a pale peach middle and a caramel brown base, with two black dot eyes and a wide grin, leaning forward with two tiny arms holding thin dark chocolate reins; two short white speed lines behind the donut; the donut is much bigger than its rider; simple shapes and very few details; the bottom of the donut is the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN: Subject: Gumball Gunner, a chunky cute living jellybean gunner: the whole body is one big fat upright jellybean, a smooth rounded bean shape of glossy vanilla cream white with a hard white highlight and pale caramel shading, with no separate head and no neck; the face is on the bean itself, two big round black dot eyes, one of them squinting to aim, and a small smile; a thin cotton-candy pink bandana tied round its top; two tiny stubby arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet; it holds one oversized chunky blaster of warm caramel brown with a short wide muzzle, and on top of the blaster a round clear bubble full of small round pastel gumballs in pink, white and pale mint; no helmet, no hair and no clothes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:CAPTAIN: Subject: Confectioner, a chunky cute living caramel sweet who is a pastry cook: the whole body is one big round ball of glossy golden caramel toffee, colour #d9a05b, with a hard white highlight, with no separate head and no neck; the face is on the ball itself, big round brass goggles with pale lenses over its eyes and a small friendly smile; a tall white puffy baker's hat on top; a white baker's apron with one cotton-candy pink pocket tied round its middle; two tiny stubby caramel arms and two tiny round dark chocolate brown feet; it holds one oversized balloon whisk with a pale wire head and a pink handle upright in one hand; no crown, no coat and no hair; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:CATAPULT: Subject: Pie Launcher, a chunky cute catapult built of gingerbread: a low sturdy frame of thick warm brown gingerbread biscuit slabs piped with white icing lines and dotted with a few pink gumdrop buttons, on two big round wheels that are pink and white peppermint swirl discs; one thick throwing arm that is a pink and white striped candy cane leaning back, ending in a round biscuit cup that holds one big cream pie, a pale biscuit crust heaped with white whipped cream; no crew and no figure; wide and low; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:FIGHTER: Subject: Gumdrop portrait, a close-up of a chunky cute living gumdrop soldier: one big round dome of glossy cotton-candy pink jelly, colour #ffb8d8, dusted with small white sugar crystals, with one big hard white highlight on its top, filling most of the square; the face is on the dome itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small happy smile; a pale mint frosting frill at the bottom edge; the hooked top of a pink and white striped candy-cane spear beside it and the edge of a round pale biscuit waffle shield.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:GUARD: Subject: Marshmallow portrait, a close-up of a chunky cute living marshmallow guard: one big fat square block of matte marshmallow white with rounded corners and pale warm cream shading, filling most of the square; the face is on the block itself, two big round black dot eyes, two small cotton-candy pink cheeks and a small calm smile; a little pink frosting on its top edge; the top edge of a big square graham-cracker shield of warm caramel biscuit brown with rows of small holes in front of it.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:KNIGHT: Subject: Gummy Bear portrait, a close-up of the head and shoulders of a giant living gummy jelly sweet: a big round head of glossy translucent pink jelly, colour #f4a0c4, one single pink colour, with two small round ears on top and long hard white shine streaks; the face is only two small black dot eyes and a tiny smile pressed into the jelly; smooth round jelly shoulders and one stubby round fist raised beside the head; no fur, no muzzle patch and no nose.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Rock Candy Golem portrait, a close-up of the head and shoulders of a huge golem built of big angular rock-candy sugar crystals: a pointed crystal head of glossy cotton-candy pink sugar with hard white highlights, a face of warm caramel brown with two small dark eyes under a heavy brow and a straight mouth, huge shoulders of big faceted pink and white crystal chunks with a few tiny pastel sprinkles, and thick bands of dripping caramel across the chest.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:RAIDER: Subject: Donut Racer, a chunky cute rider on a rolling donut shown whole: one big fat ring donut standing upright on its edge like a wheel, of golden biscuit-brown dough with thick glossy cotton-candy pink frosting dripping over it, a few tiny pastel sprinkles and a round hole in its middle; on top of it one small living candy-corn sweet, a little cone with a white pointed tip, a pale peach middle and a caramel brown base, with two black dot eyes, leaning forward; two short white speed lines behind the donut.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:MARKSMAN: Subject: Gumball Gunner portrait, a close-up of a chunky cute living jellybean gunner: one big fat rounded jellybean of glossy vanilla cream white with a hard white highlight, filling most of the square; the face is on the bean itself, two big round black dot eyes and a small smile; a cotton-candy pink bandana with tiny sprinkles tied over its top; and in front of it the back of a chunky caramel brown blaster with a round clear bubble full of small pastel gumballs in pink, white and pale mint.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:CAPTAIN: Subject: Confectioner portrait, a close-up of the head and shoulders of a chunky cute living caramel sweet who is a pastry cook: a big round head of glossy golden caramel brown with pink frosting and tiny sprinkles dripping over its top, big round brass goggles with pale lenses over its eyes and a small friendly smile; a tall white puffy baker's hat on top; the top of a white apron on its shoulders; and a balloon whisk with a pale wire head and a pink handle raised beside the head; no crown, no coat and no hair.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:CATAPULT: Subject: Pie Launcher, a chunky cute pie cannon on a gingerbread cart shown whole: a low sturdy cart of warm brown gingerbread biscuit slabs piped with white icing lines and dotted with pink gumdrop buttons, on big round pink and white peppermint swirl wheels; on the cart one fat short barrel of glossy cotton-candy pink frosting with pink and white stripes, tilted up, holding at its mouth one big cream pie, a round pale biscuit crust heaped with white whipped cream; no crew and no face.
subjects.CITY:CANDY:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 candy village, the first of three sizes of one settlement: one little gingerbread house of warm biscuit brown with a thick roof of white frosting and a round pale pink door, one small round cupcake hut with a swirl of pale pink frosting for a roof beside it, and one lollipop tree, a round pale pink and white swirl disc on a white stick; no wall, no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:CANDY:2/CALM: Subject: a medium level-2 candy town, the second of three sizes of one settlement: one round keep built like a two-layer cake of pale cream sponge with pale pink frosting dripping from its top edge and a round pale pink door, two little gingerbread houses of warm biscuit brown with thick white frosting roofs, and one lollipop tree with a pale pink and white swirl, packed tightly inside a low wall of pale biscuit wafers topped with small pale pink gumdrops; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:CANDY:3/CALM: Subject: a large level-3 candy castle city, the biggest of three sizes of one settlement, crowded and grand: a tall castle built like a three-tier cake of pale cream sponge with pale pink frosting dripping from every tier, two round cake towers with pointed roofs that are upside-down pale biscuit wafer cones, several little gingerbread houses of warm biscuit brown with thick white frosting roofs filling it from side to side, and two lollipop trees with pale pink and white swirls, inside a wall of pale biscuit wafers topped with small pale pink gumdrops; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:SUGAR_RUSH: Subject: one big round lollipop, a flat disc with a bold cotton-candy pink and white swirl, whose stick is a thick jagged white lightning bolt pointing down, with two small white sparkle stars beside it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:REBAKE: Subject: one balloon whisk, a pink handle with a big rounded cage of thick pale grey wire loops, crossed over one big padded oven mitt of cotton-candy pink with a white cuff; both drawn large, filling the square; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:CANDY:FORTIFICATION: Subject: Home Sweet Home: one small gingerbread house of warm biscuit brown with a thick roof of white frosting, a round cotton-candy pink door with a small pink heart above it and two pink gumdrops on the roof; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:CRASHED: Subject: one bold dizzy spiral, a thick dark chocolate brown line winding three times to its centre on a pale cream disc, with three small white four-pointed stars circling above it; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.CRUMBS: Subject: a small heap of cookie crumbs: three broken pieces of a pale golden biscuit with bitten edges lying in a low heap, with many small loose crumbs scattered round them, one small blob of cotton-candy pink frosting and a few tiny white sugar grains; low and wide, much smaller than a unit; nothing else in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:SPLAT: Subject: a splat of whipped cream: one big flat round blob of pure white cream seen from the front, with six thick rounded white splashes flying outward from it and a few small cotton-candy pink drops between them; white and pink only; round overall; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:PIE: Subject: a flying cream pie seen from the side: one shallow round pale biscuit crust heaped with white whipped cream with one small pink sweet on top, with two short white speed lines behind it; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:PEPPERMINT_POP: Subject: a burst of peppermint: one round pink and white swirl sweet cracking apart in the middle, with eight sharp pink and white striped shards flying outward in every direction and a few small white sparks; round overall; floating in empty space.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Candy, a chunky cute small chocolate-bar boat seen from the front-right: a short round hull that is a dark chocolate bar marked into square blocks with a thick rim of cotton-candy pink frosting, one square sail that is a pale biscuit wafer with a waffle grid on a pink and white striped candy-cane mast, and a small pale pink pennant; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Candy, a chunky cute big layered-cake galleon seen from the front-right: a long hull of layers of pale cream sponge cake with cotton-candy pink frosting dripping from its top edge, a round cake tower with white whipped cream on top, white cream sails on pink and white striped candy-cane masts, and small pale pink pennants; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CANDY:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Candy, a chunky cute donut raft seen from the front-right: one big fat ring donut of golden biscuit-brown dough floating flat, with thick glossy cotton-candy pink frosting and tiny white sprinkles on its top, a heap of white whipped cream in its middle, oars at its sides and a small pink and white candy cane as its pole; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Candy shown whole from the front-right: a small dark chocolate-bar boat with a rim of cotton-candy pink frosting, a pale biscuit wafer sail on a pink and white candy-cane mast and a small pale pink pennant; no water.
subjects.PORTRAIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Candy shown whole from the front-right: a big layered-cake galleon of pale cream sponge with cotton-candy pink frosting, round cake towers with white whipped cream, white cream sails on pink and white candy-cane masts and small pale pink pennants; no water.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:SUGAR_TOSS: Subject: one wrapped sweet, a fat round cotton-candy pink sweet in a wrapper with two twisted white fan-shaped ends, flying up and to the right along one thick curved white arrow; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:CANDY:TEND_WOUNDED: Subject: Frosting: one white cloth piping bag held at an angle, with a small caramel brown nozzle squeezing out a thick swirl of cotton-candy pink frosting; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:TECH:CANDY:EXPLOSIVES: Subject: Peppermint Surprise: one round peppermint sweet, a flat disc with a bold cotton-candy pink and white swirl, with a short dark fuse on its top burning with one small white spark star; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:SPLAT: Subject: one cream pie hitting flat and bursting, seen from the front: a round pale biscuit crust with white whipped cream splashing outward in five thick white blobs; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BOUNCE: Subject: one thick coiled spring of cotton-candy pink with four coils, with one fat square white marshmallow sitting on its top and two short curved white motion lines above it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:RUSHED: Subject: one bold jagged lightning bolt with cotton-candy pink and white candy-cane stripes and a dark outline, with two small white sparkle stars beside it; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:SPLATTED: Subject: one big splat of white whipped cream seen from the front: a thick round white blob with five rounded splashes sticking out and three drips running down from its bottom, with a few small pale biscuit crumbs on it; white with pale cream shading; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:HUD:CANDY:EMBLEM: Subject: one wrapped sweet: a fat round sweet in a cotton-candy pink wrapper with one white stripe round its middle and two twisted fan-shaped wrapper ends, one on each side; flat and simple, symmetrical; nothing else in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:GUMBALL_SHOT: Subject: a small round gumball flying fast to the right: one glossy ball of cotton-candy pink with one white shine dot, and three short white speed lines behind it; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:SUGAR_TOSS: Subject: a tossed sweet: one fat round cotton-candy pink sweet in a wrapper with two twisted white fan-shaped ends, tumbling at an angle, with two small white sparkle stars beside it; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:REBAKE_PUFF: Subject: one round fluffy puff of warm cream-white oven steam made of four soft round lumps with pale pink shading, with a few small pale biscuit crumbs and two small white sparkle stars round it; floating in empty space.
subjects.EFFECT:BOUNCE: Subject: a bouncing spring: one thick coiled spring of cotton-candy pink with four coils and white shine, squashed flat and wide, with two curved white motion arcs above it; floating in empty space.
